text:
alex: Starting post-deploy synth summary for release r2026-03-23-11 (canary -> wave-2)

deploy-bot: synth-id=20260323-11-776830 results: kv-signature-checksum probe
- mismatch_rate: 0.47% (expected <0.01%)
- p95 kv-prefill latency: +95ms vs baseline
- sampled failures: 5/1024

lisa: dashboards show p95 rising around the 50% ramp to wave-2, looks correlated.

rachel: can someone paste the failed key list (sanitized) so we can replay quickly?

kevin: here are the sanitized keys: ```["user:2222/prefX","session:4444/prefY","embed:aa101","meta:zz1","cache:tmp9"]```

kevin: kicking a replay against r2026-03-22-21 now: `/run-synth --suite=kv-signature --ids=20260323-11-776830 --build=r2026-03-22-21`

deploy-bot: replay result: prior-build signatures matched expected for sampled keys

kevin: sounds like a regression in r2026-03-23-11.

nora: PR#4901 modified the serializer to stream-sort keys for perf. I noted a change from deterministic sort -> stream-optimized emission. Could explain checksum ordering differences.

alex: suggestion: pause the rollout, pin wave-2 to previous build, cut a revert hotfix that restores deterministic ordering. Thoughts?

rachel: agree. I'll open a pin request in the runbook and notify CS to hold release notes until we confirm impact.

lisa: opening runbook entry: https://runbook.internal/releases/776830/pin-request (lisa)

deploy-bot: Rollout hold applied to wave-2. Traffic pinned to r2026-03-22-21. Canary frozen at 50%.

kevin: creating branch hotfix/4901-reinstate-order, running unit tests + quick synth (ETA ~20m).

nora: drafting changelog: "kv serializer: restore deterministic key ordering to fix signature mismatches". Will include synth evidence.

alex: temporary mitigation: enable prefix-only checksum compare for canary to reduce noise and catch only strong mismatches. Ops to flip it?

lisa: will coord with ops. also bump synth sample rate for 30m to get more coverage.

kevin: CI green for hotfix branch. running quick-suite: `/run-synth --suite=kv-signature --build=hotfix/4901-reinstate-order --samples=2500`

deploy-bot: quick-suite finished: 0 mismatches on 2500 samples, p95 latency back to baseline.

rachel: approved. rolling hotfix to wave-2 with staged ramp: 5% -> 20% -> 50% -> 100%. Monitoring at each step for 15m.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout started: hotfix/4901-reinstate-order -> wave-2 (5% initial)

lisa: dashboards show checksum rate dropped to 0% within 4 minutes and p95 normalized. Ops confirms we can remove the prefix-only mitigation. :thumbsup:

nora: merging revert into main and adding a unit test that asserts stable serializer ordering for regular and edge keys.

kevin: post-release checklist items noted: add deterministic-serializer unit test, extend nightly synth kv-signature sampling to include edge prefixes, tighten alert threshold to 0.05% sustained over 5m.

alex: I'll own the postmortem doc. initial action items:
- unit test for deterministic serializer ordering (owner: nora)
- increase synth sampling & add edge key coverage (owner: kevin)
- update alerting threshold and auto-pause rule (owner: lisa)
- document canary prefill warmup timing in rollout guide (owner: alex)

rachel: drafting blameless summary for stakeholders and will update release notes once postmortem is done. ETA EOD.

deploy-bot: hotfix rollout completed to wave-2 and then full rollout. No further checksum regressions detected. Incident: mitigated, postmortem assigned.

kevin: closing thread — great cross-team response. :tada:
